name: Sin Being Equal
overview: Scripture reveals that all humans have sinned and fall short of God's glory, emphasizing the universal condition of unrighteousness (Romans 3:10, 23). While many sins and blasphemies can be forgiven, there is a unique and unforgivable sin against the Holy Spirit (Matthew 12:31). The nature of sin is contrasted with truth, as those who reject God align with the devil, the originator of lies and murder (John 8:44). Historical accounts, such as the Galileans' blood mingled with sacrifices, serve as reminders of human sinfulness and the consequences of rebellion against God (Luke 13:1).
